narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.55 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.05602-0.05719 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.05805; the first objective pays 1.70R at 0.05548.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.05805 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
